reader_summary.headline: Today, we're featuring another episode of The Rewind.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we're featuring another episode of The Rewind, in which Howard looks back on some of his memos over the years, discusses their origins. In this episode, Howard reflects on It's All a Big Mistake, which was originally published on June 20th, 2012, in conversation with Bob O'Leary. Howard and Bob were interviewed by Anna Schumansky, Oak Tree's senior financial writer.

thesis: The memo argues that distressed investing is an inherently anti-error business model because it allows investors to examine flawed underwriting assumptions made by original holders who have often lost faith in the assets. By entering at valuations far superior to the original investors and leveraging the fact that one party must have made a mistake, the strategy seeks to find assets that appear scary from the outside but are not as problematic as they seem upon investigation.
